picks.title: EP: 447 Real Life Miracles and the Voice of God with Ryan Bethea and Abby Robertson *members only trailer
picks.summary: She saw the tumor months before the diagnosis. While praying over her seemingly healthy mother, Abby Robertson had a vision so disturbing she could not bring herself to write it down. Two to three months later, her mother was diagnosed with pancreatic cancer, already spreading and beyond surgery. Abby prayed with a certainty she had never felt, convinced God had prepared her to witness a healing. What happened next sent her searching for answers she is still looking for. In this episode, she and Ryan Bethea of The Exorcist Files sit down with Nate and Luke to talk about what it actually means
picks.reason: A woman’s vision and faith tested by illness and search for healing.

picks.showTitle: No Small Endeavor with Lee C. Camp
picks.title: 271: Unabridged Interview: Lee Warren
picks.summary:
This is our unabridged interview with W. Lee Warren.



Can you change your brain? The anxious tendencies, the recurring grief, the patterns of rumination? Our guest today says you can.

Dr. W. Lee Warren is a neurosurgeon and Iraq War veteran who performed 200 brain surgeries in a tent hospital during the war, came home carrying PTSD he wouldn't name for years, and later lost his 19-year-old son to murder. His book, The Life-Changing Art of Self-Brain Surgery, argues that the mind can reshape the very brain it thinks through, and that no grief, trauma, or lifelong pattern gets the final word
picks.reason: A neurosurgeon discusses trauma, grief, and reshaping the mind after profound loss.
